summary: to see just beyond the bend where mystery finds end truth lights the vanguard as nature opens their courtyard and our realities sank on edges of a broken riverbank #smallpoems #ds106
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
to see just beyond the bend
where mystery finds end
truth lights the vanguard
as nature opens their courtyard
and our realities sank
on edges of a broken riverbank
#smallpoems
#ds106
